note: SYNTHETIC-until-validated-on-real-traffic. H9 warm-start priors from previous deployments.

worlds.name: A1-sim-fixed
worlds.note: sim Fixed (hand-designed traps+drift); pool = other seeds of the SAME hidden skills (related)

worlds.name: A2-sim-random
worlds.note: sim Random: hidden skills redrawn per seed; pool shares only vocabulary/structure, no agent identity (randomized world)

worlds.name: A3-sim-notraps
worlds.note: sim NoTraps: keyword map correct pre-drift; skills random per seed

worlds.name: A4-big32
worlds.note: f3 BigWorld 32 agents x 48 types, skills random per seed (first 2000 tasks, pre-drift)

worlds.name: A5-sim-mismatch
worlds.note: WRONG prior: pool = sim Fixed, eval = sim Random (same vocabulary, unrelated skills)

worlds.name: B1-md-related
worlds.note: multi-domain agency pool, 10% of domains re-drawn, sigma .05, decoy .3; pool = same family

worlds.name: B2-md-partial
worlds.note: as B1 but 40% of domains re-drawn per deployment (partially related)

worlds.name: B4-md-shift
worlds.note: POOL DISTRIBUTION SHIFT: eval has drift, 2 new agents unknown to the pool, decoy .5, different domain mix

worlds.name: B5-md-heldout-family
worlds.note: HELD-OUT FAMILY: pool = agency structure; eval = latent-factor pool, half the vocabulary renamed

worlds.name: B6-md-wrong
worlds.note: WRONG prior: every domain's specialist structure moved to a different agent

worlds.name: B7-md-equal
worlds.note: 8 identical agents: nothing to win (sanity control)

worlds.name: B9-md-uninformative-fb
worlds.note: uninformative feedback: related pool, but the reward the router sees in this deployment is an agent-independent coin

worlds.name: B8-md-noinfo
worlds.note: no-prior-info world: skills random per deployment, pool deployments are mutually inconsistent
